mode.description: dark or light. Drives shadow tints, grain blend, and light calibrations. Match your bg lightness.

bgElevated.description: Card / raised surface color. Must visibly differ from bg.

accent2.description: Secondary accent (gradient end). For gradient features keep hue distance >= 30 deg from accent1.

text.description: Primary text. Must hit WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) against bg.

textDim.description: Body / secondary text. Must be >= 4:1 against bg.

textMuted.description: Tertiary text (labels, dates). Must be >= 3:1 against bg AND a perceptible step between textDim and bg. NEVER near bg.

shadow.description: Shadow color. Black-based on dark; for neon themes a low-opacity accent-tinted shadow reads better.

headingFont.description: Any Google Font family name. No allow-list - vary your choice across users to match domain and tone.

bodyFont.description: Any Google Font family - must be highly legible. Don't pair two display fonts.

googleFontsUrl.description: Valid Google Fonts CSS URL that loads BOTH families with the weights you'll use (heading ~400-800, body ~300-500).

headingCase.description: uppercase-tracked adds uppercase + letter-spacing to labels & headings; AVOID with serif headings.

base.description: solid (flat - looks like no backdrop, avoid pairing with all-none); gradient-tone (subtle same-hue light); duotone (accent wash into bg).

pattern.description: Surface pattern, edge-masked. topo currently renders as fine dots.

glow.description: corner = top-right accent glow; spotlight = top-center beam.

vignette.description: Darkens edges. Don't stack with grain + pattern + glow simultaneously (reads noisy).

elevation.description: flat (no shadow, borders separate); ambient (soft diffuse); layered (stronger lift).

shadowQuality.description: soft = big blur low opacity; crisp = tight defined.

surfaceContrast.description: Amplifies bg <-> bgElevated gap. low = barely lift; high = clearly distinct.

radius.description: Global rounding for cards/inputs/thumbnails. ~2px / ~14px / ~26px. Tags always pill.

contentWidth.description: Reserved - not yet wired. Safe to emit, no visual effect yet.

card.description: border (border+bg); shadow (elevation); glass (frosted blur); tinted (accent-tinted bg); clay (accent bg + inset highlight).

tag.description: outline; subtle (translucent); filled (accent gradient tint); shadow.

primary.description: filled (solid accent); gradient (accent1->accent2, requires >=30 deg hue distance).

sectionHeading.description: stacked (label+title vertically — default); centered (label+title centred); sidebar (label/title in side column); divider (full-width rule separates heading).

sectionTitle.description: plain (regular text); gradient (accent1->accent2 fill); outline (stroke text); highlight (accent-tinted bg behind title).

frame.description: Avatar treatment. dual-tone RECOLORS the actual photo - only for strongly stylized themes with vivid accents (saturation >= 0.4).

hero.description: Hero layout. split needs profile photo; overlay-typographic needs title<=30 chars; manifesto needs shortIntro>=30 chars. editorial-masthead is the universal fallback — no data requirements.

experience.description: timeline (dot+rail, >=2 items); split-rail (alternating, >=3 items, premium); cards; compact.

projects.description: bento needs all items to have thumbnails; featured needs >=2; alternating 2-5.

certifications.description: badges needs all items to have thumbnails.

intensity.description: none disables all motion; expressive gates extras like hero-name glow.

linkHover.description: arrow adds a moving arrow to primary buttons.

counters.description: Animate stat numbers counting up. Only meaningful if about.highlights exists.
